role_summary: Leads total event execution, owns event-day decisions, cross-functional coordination, escalation, safety and closeout.
pre_event: Final production review; department leader alignment; approve run-of-show and staffing.
load_in: Executive call; lead all-hands; approve doors/opening readiness.
live_event: Command center oversight; resolve escalations; protect guest experience and schedule.
closeout: Lead debrief; approve incident/action items; confirm closeout.
training_requirements: Event leadership, escalation, safety, Sanctuary standards

role_summary: Owns site operations, staffing deployment, logistics, venue readiness, operational handoffs and event closeout.
pre_event: Confirm site plan, staffing positions, supplies, radios and operational checklist.
load_in: Operations call; venue walkthrough; deploy teams and equipment.
live_event: Manage operational flow, staffing gaps, venue coordination and issue resolution.
closeout: Supervise breakdown, inventory and venue handback.
training_requirements: Venue ops, radio protocol, emergency procedures, incident escalation

role_summary: Runs show flow and calls cues across stage, production, talent and front-of-house.
pre_event: Review run-of-show, cue sheets, talent schedule and production notes.
load_in: Production call; cue-to-cue; confirm backstage and comms readiness.
live_event: Call show; manage transitions, holds, timing and stage access.
closeout: Confirm show close; archive cue notes and production issues.
training_requirements: Show calling, comms, stage safety, run-of-show

role_summary: Primary operational liaison for venue/site conditions, access, house rules and facility readiness.
pre_event: Confirm venue access, loading, utilities, parking, restrictions and handback requirements.
load_in: Site call; open access points; coordinate venue representatives.
live_event: Monitor facility conditions, access, vendor compliance and venue issues.
closeout: Complete venue walkthrough and handback documentation.
training_requirements: Venue rules, site safety, emergency exits, escalation

role_summary: Owns arrival-to-departure guest journey and leads Host, check-in, seating, VIP and accessibility functions.
pre_event: Review guest journey, staffing grid, VIP list, accessibility needs and service standards.
load_in: Guest Experience call; position briefing; entrance readiness check.
live_event: Supervise guest-facing teams; resolve service issues; manage flow and recovery.
closeout: Guest-facing debrief; lost-and-found and service issue handoff.
training_requirements: Hospitality standards, de-escalation, accessibility, emergency procedures

role_summary: Leads Host team and ensures consistent welcome, wayfinding and guest connection.
pre_event: Review host roster, zones, talking points and guest FAQs.
load_in: Host call; assign zones; run hospitality briefing.
live_event: Coach Hosts; rebalance zones; handle escalated guest needs.
closeout: Account for team; capture guest issues and follow-up needs.
training_requirements: Sanctuary hospitality, guest recovery, wayfinding, radio protocol

role_summary: Creates the Sanctuary guest experience through welcome, wayfinding, connection and event support.
pre_event: Review assignment, event information and guest-service expectations.
load_in: Check in; receive zone assignment; prepare entry/guest areas.
live_event: Welcome guests; answer questions; support flow; identify needs; connect guests to resources.
closeout: Assist departure; report issues; complete team checkout.
training_requirements: Hospitality, event briefing, safety, accessibility awareness

role_summary: Owns registration/check-in station, attendee lookup, exception handling and counts.
pre_event: Validate attendee workflow, devices, lists, credentials and exception process.
load_in: Check-in call; test systems; stage lanes and signage.
live_event: Lead check-in; resolve lookup/ticket exceptions; report counts.
closeout: Reconcile counts and unresolved registration issues.
training_requirements: Registration tools, privacy, escalation, accessibility

role_summary: Processes guest arrival and registration accurately while maintaining a premium welcome.
pre_event: Review check-in procedure and privacy expectations.
load_in: Station setup; device test; lane assignment.
live_event: Check in guests; issue credentials where authorized; route exceptions to lead.
closeout: Close station; return devices/materials; report unresolved cases.
training_requirements: Registration tools, privacy, guest service

role_summary: Manages seating, floor capacity, reserved areas and guest movement.
pre_event: Review floor plan, capacity, reserved sections and accessibility seating.
load_in: Walk floor; brief ushers; verify aisles and reserved markers.
live_event: Manage seating and capacity; protect aisles; coordinate late seating and overflow.
closeout: Clear floor; report seating/capacity issues.
training_requirements: Capacity, accessibility, evacuation routes, guest recovery

role_summary: Guides guests to appropriate seating and protects safe, orderly floor flow.
pre_event: Review zone and floor plan.
load_in: Receive zone; inspect seating area and aisles.
live_event: Seat guests; maintain aisles; assist accessibility and overflow routing.
closeout: Assist orderly exit and reset.
training_requirements: Seating plan, accessibility, emergency exits

role_summary: Coordinates VIP, artist and special-guest hospitality within approved scope.
pre_event: Review approved guest list, hospitality plan, access rules and special requirements.
load_in: Prepare hospitality areas; coordinate credentials and arrivals.
live_event: Manage approved VIP/artist hospitality and handoffs; escalate changes.
closeout: Close hospitality areas; reconcile materials and notes.
training_requirements: Confidentiality, hospitality standards, access control

role_summary: Supports guests requiring accessibility accommodations or additional navigation assistance.
pre_event: Review venue accessibility plan and escalation contacts.
load_in: Inspect accessible routes/seating; coordinate with Guest Experience Manager.
live_event: Assist guests with approved accommodations and accessible routing; escalate needs appropriately.
closeout: Report accessibility barriers and unresolved follow-up.
training_requirements: Accessibility awareness, respectful assistance, emergency procedures

role_summary: Owns promoter strategy, assignments, campaign standards, attribution and performance review.
pre_event: Set promoter plan, targets, approved assets, campaign/referral structure and assignments.
load_in: Promoter lead check-in; final campaign/status review.
live_event: Monitor promoter arrivals, guest/referral performance and field issues.
closeout: Reconcile promoter results, attendance attribution and follow-up.
training_requirements: Brand standards, referral attribution, compliance, guest conduct

role_summary: Leads a promoter pod, reinforces approved messaging and helps coordinate event-day promoter activity.
pre_event: Review campaign, assigned promoter pod, targets and approved outreach.
load_in: Check in promoter pod; verify referral tools and event talking points.
live_event: Support promoter team; coordinate arrivals and approved on-site promotion.
closeout: Submit pod results, issues and follow-up notes.
training_requirements: Brand messaging, referral tools, conduct, escalation

role_summary: Drives awareness and attendance through approved personal, social and community outreach.
pre_event: Use approved campaign assets, referral code and outreach plan.
load_in: Check in; receive event-specific instructions and approved materials.
live_event: Support approved promotion, guest arrivals and referral attribution; follow conduct standards.
closeout: Submit results and required closeout information.
training_requirements: Brand standards, referral attribution, conduct, event briefing

role_summary: Coordinates approved physical/community outreach activations and street-team deployment.
pre_event: Confirm approved locations, materials, permissions and team assignments.
load_in: Deploy team; issue materials; review safety and conduct.
live_event: Supervise outreach zones; protect brand and venue/community relationships.
closeout: Reconcile materials and outreach results.
training_requirements: Brand conduct, local/site rules, safety, escalation

role_summary: Executes approved in-person outreach and event awareness campaigns.
pre_event: Review approved activation plan and messaging.
load_in: Check in; receive zone/materials.
live_event: Conduct respectful outreach only in approved areas; capture approved attribution.
closeout: Return materials; report results/issues.
training_requirements: Brand messaging, conduct, safety

role_summary: Owns technical production, vendor/crew coordination, systems readiness and production safety.
pre_event: Advance audio, lighting, video, power, stage and vendor requirements.
load_in: Production call; system checks; lead technical readiness.
live_event: Supervise technical execution and resolve production failures.
closeout: Lead technical strike and equipment/vendor reconciliation.
training_requirements: Technical safety, power, comms, emergency shutdown

role_summary: Owns front-of-house audio quality and system operation.
pre_event: Review input list, playback, microphones and venue audio plan.
load_in: Audio call; line check; soundcheck; confirm playback and comms.
live_event: Mix program; manage audio cues and troubleshoot safely.
closeout: Power-down/strike per plan; document issues.
training_requirements: Audio system, hearing safety, electrical safety, show cues

role_summary: Manages stage monitoring, artist audio support and stage patch within approved production plan.
pre_event: Review stage plot, inputs and monitor requirements.
load_in: Stage audio call; patch; monitor check; soundcheck.
live_event: Operate monitors/stage audio and support changeovers.
closeout: Strike stage audio and report technical issues.
training_requirements: Stage audio, cable safety, artist communication

role_summary: Owns event lighting look, cues and safe operation.
pre_event: Review lighting plot, cue list and venue limitations.
load_in: Lighting call; focus/check fixtures; cue review.
live_event: Run lighting cues and maintain safe audience/stage lighting.
closeout: Safe shutdown/strike and issue report.
training_requirements: Lighting console, rigging awareness, electrical safety

role_summary: Runs approved screens, playback and presentation media.
pre_event: Validate media files, playback order, outputs and backups.
load_in: Video call; test screens/playback; cue review.
live_event: Execute playback and screen cues; troubleshoot signal issues.
closeout: Archive show notes; safe shutdown/strike.
training_requirements: Playback systems, signal flow, content handling

role_summary: Coordinates live broadcast output, stream readiness and broadcast crew.
pre_event: Review run-of-show, platform plan, graphics, audio/video feeds and contingency.
load_in: Broadcast call; verify encoder/feeds/graphics and test stream.
live_event: Direct broadcast flow and coordinate production cues.
closeout: End stream; verify recording/asset handoff and incident notes.
training_requirements: Broadcast workflow, platform access, privacy/content rules

role_summary: Captures approved live/event footage according to production direction.
pre_event: Review shot plan, camera position and content restrictions.
load_in: Camera call; setup; white balance/focus/comms check.
live_event: Operate assigned camera and follow director instructions.
closeout: Return media/equipment and report issues.
training_requirements: Camera operation, cable safety, privacy/content rules

role_summary: Supports safe load-in, stage setup, changeovers and strike.
pre_event: Review call sheet, load-in plan and equipment responsibilities.
load_in: Load-in; stage setup; cable/equipment placement under direction.
live_event: Support changeovers, resets and technical needs.
closeout: Strike, pack and inventory equipment.
training_requirements: Manual handling, cable safety, stage safety, PPE as required

role_summary: Owns approved talent communication, schedules, hospitality handoffs and backstage coordination.
pre_event: Confirm schedules, contacts, arrival instructions and approved requirements.
load_in: Talent call; verify green rooms, credentials and schedule.
live_event: Coordinate talent movement and approved requests; protect schedule and access.
closeout: Confirm departures, unresolved requirements and closeout notes.
training_requirements: Confidentiality, artist relations, access control, escalation

role_summary: Maintains backstage/green-room readiness and approved talent support.
pre_event: Prepare rooms, signage, schedules and approved hospitality items.
load_in: Backstage call; room check; access briefing.
live_event: Maintain backstage order, approved hospitality and schedule support.
closeout: Reset/close rooms; inventory and issue report.
training_requirements: Confidentiality, backstage conduct, access control

role_summary: Coordinates contracted/venue security, access control and incident escalation; does not replace licensed security requirements.
pre_event: Review venue security plan, emergency contacts, access zones and incident process.
load_in: Security briefing; confirm posts, emergency exits and escalation tree.
live_event: Coordinate security response and access-control issues; document incidents.
closeout: Incident reconciliation and security closeout.
training_requirements: Venue emergency plan, incident command, access control; licensing as applicable

role_summary: Owns credential zones and staff/vendor/talent access verification.
pre_event: Review credential matrix, entrances and exception process.
load_in: Set access points; brief credential staff and security.
live_event: Verify credentials and route exceptions to authorized lead.
closeout: Collect/reconcile temporary credentials and report access issues.
training_requirements: Credential policy, privacy, de-escalation, emergency access

role_summary: Coordinates operational incident documentation and response handoffs under the venue emergency plan.
pre_event: Review emergency plan, medical/security contacts and incident forms.
load_in: Safety walkthrough; verify exits, reporting channels and response resources.
live_event: Coordinate non-clinical incident response, documentation and escalation to qualified responders.
closeout: Finalize incident records and action items.
training_requirements: Emergency plan, incident documentation, stop-work/escalation authority

role_summary: Owns load-in/out sequence, delivery windows, staging areas and equipment movement.
pre_event: Build load plan, delivery schedule and staging map.
load_in: Logistics call; receive deliveries; coordinate dock/loading access.
live_event: Manage movement of supplies/equipment and maintain clear operational routes.
closeout: Lead load-out, reconcile deliveries/equipment and close loading areas.
training_requirements: Manual handling, loading safety, venue routes, radio protocol

role_summary: Executes physical event setup, resets and breakdown under operational direction.
pre_event: Review call time, assigned setup zone and equipment.
load_in: Setup tables, signage, barriers, furnishings and approved event elements.
live_event: Support resets, replenishment and operational moves.
closeout: Break down, pack, clean assigned area and inventory items.
training_requirements: Manual handling, safe lifting, venue safety

role_summary: Maintains guest-facing cleanliness, supplies and facility issue response with venue teams.
pre_event: Review cleaning plan, restrooms, waste, consumables and venue responsibilities.
load_in: Facility walkthrough; stage supplies; confirm escalation contacts.
live_event: Monitor cleanliness and facility issues; coordinate replenishment and response.
closeout: Final cleanliness walkthrough and supply/waste reconciliation.
training_requirements: Chemical/PPE rules as applicable, venue procedures, incident reporting

role_summary: Runs staff check-in, credential issuance, call-time tracking and administrative event records.
pre_event: Prepare roster, credentials, sign-in tools and staffing updates.
load_in: Open staff check-in; issue credentials; record arrivals and exceptions.
live_event: Maintain staffing status, relay no-shows/changes and support admin needs.
closeout: Reconcile roster/credentials and submit attendance record.
training_requirements: Privacy, credential control, staff procedures

role_summary: Coordinates approved cashless point-of-sale or merchandise operations; financial controls remain subject to Sanctuary LV Group policy.
pre_event: Review products/pricing, POS devices, inventory and approved financial controls.
load_in: Commerce call; count inventory; test POS; assign stations.
live_event: Supervise transactions/inventory and escalate discrepancies; no unauthorized cash handling.
closeout: Reconcile inventory/POS reports and secure equipment per policy.
training_requirements: POS procedures, inventory control, privacy, financial controls
